lifecycle.factory: real create_deferred_afd_npu_profiler(role, role_rank=rank) freezes env on management thread without constructing backend
lifecycle.attention: afd_npu_profiler_execute on process main execute thread, three successful initial matmul steps, stop request applied at next execute, restart(prefix=restart), three steps, afd_npu_profiler_owner finish on main thread
lifecycle.ffn: one background owner creates NPU tensors and backend; Queue commands gate before_step -> matmul -> step; management records stop/restart requested/applied/pending/step fields while no next command can reach owner; next released step applies request; finish only on owner
lifecycle.queue_contract: synchronization is by bounded Queue.get/put, not sleeps, latency limits or a fabricated connector receive
lifecycle.oracle: 64x64 FP32 matmul of small exact integers; CPU matmul output compared with zero tolerance on every step; CPU transfer/synchronization intentional, not a performance test
lifecycle.step_semantics: three recorded execute/parent steps each cycle; unprofiled stop-boundary arithmetic does not advance profiler steps; final steps=6

trace_evidence.source_contract: profiler.py:180-196 tensorboard_trace_handler default async_mode=False, forwarded into analyse; deeper C++/analysis completion is not inferred
trace_evidence.collection: After owner finish, identify Ascend Hardware process_name + matching NPU label pid; select ph=X / AI_CORE / MatMul device events. Match Name/TaskID/StreamID multiset against the actual device AI_CORE kernel_details.csv rows, require two active events per initial/restart phase. CPU labels/aten record_function events cannot qualify.
trace_evidence.missing_or_unrecognized_trace: pending-or-unproven, including malformed trace/CSV; child rc2 and supervisor not successful; no fake trace or assumed complete export
trace_evidence.limits: does not prove global C++ TLS, every auxiliary thread, native FFN daemon/RPC receive, or full request timeline
